meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查看、添加或删除 NanoClaw agent 容器可访问的主机目录允许清单(存放在 ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json),并标明每个目录是只读还是可读写;改动在容器启动时读取生效。
howto.when: 当你提到「mounts」「mount allowlist」等关键词,或要求让 agent 访问某个主机目录、调整容器挂载权限时触发。

say.text: 列出当前允许 agent 访问的目录
say.note: 显示清单及只读/可读写状态

say.text: 把 /data/reports 加进允许清单,设为只读
say.note: 先校验路径存在再写入配置
展示现有清单后改写配置

howto.what_en: Claude can view, add, or remove the host directories NanoClaw agent containers may access (~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json), showing each as read-only or read-write. Changes apply when a container spawns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "mounts", "mount allowlist", or ask to give agents access to a host directory or change container mount permissions.

say_en.text: List the directories agents are allowed to mount
say_en.note: Shows the list with read-only/read-write states

say_en.text: Add /data/reports to the allowlist as read-only
say_en.note: Validates the path, then writes the config
Shows the list, then rewrites the config
